scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text:
How would you define victory?
To fell the enemy...
However, the most important thing is...
Never to fall yourself!

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text:
For that, you must better protect yourself.
You cannot protect 'others' while you hinder your 'own' protection.
Combine armor.
End conversation.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text: Prudence is also an important virtue in battle.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text: Wolf Armguard... One beastly piece of armor.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text:
Do you feel the nature of the wolf?
Both wild and charming...

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text: Crescent Armguard... A thing of beauty and strength... With none the lesser.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text:
Such beauty...
As if the whole body is overflowing with magic.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text: Ninja Scale Armor... It's said that a legendary Ninja once wore it.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text:
This is truly a legendary armor...
Even if I don't believe in legends...

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text: Shadow King's Armor... It was made to protect others.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text:
How is it?
Does the armor not appear as if there are two?

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text:
You don't have enough ingredients.
Look again...
Combine.
Quit.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text: Looks like you need more time to decide.

A crescent as beautiful and clear as a crystal will be engraved on it.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text:

You can feel its legendary powers.

scripts.speaker: Gyo
scripts.text:
To make a ^ff0000Shadow King's Armor, you'll need a Special Ninja Suit with a slot and 10 Dark Pieces^000000.
With the darkness it erases existence itself...
